question_text: A citizen, Mr. Lim, submitted a request for a business permit to the local government. After 20 days, he has not received any response. Under RA 6713, what is the obligation of the government office regarding Mr. Lim's request?

options.text: The office must act on the request within 15 working days from receipt, and failure to do so may be considered a violation of the Code.
The office has 30 days to respond because business permits are complex documents.
The office may ignore the request if it is incomplete, without any obligation to inform Mr. Lim.
The office must respond only if Mr. Lim follows up with a formal complaint.
